cacheScopeExplanation.message: Aggressive keeps lyric and translation results for 24 hours; Moderate keeps them for 12 hours. With caching off, results are not stored, while provider indexes may still refresh when online. Clearing caches removes results only: local TTML, lyric offsets, source preferences and fonts are kept. Provider indexes are not cleared or included in the sizes above.
